name: Mcmon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Appmon] trait and 1 card with the [Entertainment] or [Awakening (App Name)] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
source_effect: Trash any 1 digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
link_requirements:
Link Requirements [Link] [Appmon] trait: Cost 1
(Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)
